en.title: R
en.summary: The letter R is the seventeenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name is the sound /r/, that is a rolled r. Its main sound is the sound /r/, that is a rolled r, as in (rac) /rak/, which means crayfish. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: To make the first sound, place your tongue tip against the tooth ridge behind your top teeth. Push air out so the tongue tip taps quickly against the ridge. To make the second sound, tap your tongue tip while raising the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Hold your hand against your throat to feel your voice buzz.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: In all standard positions, this letter makes the sound /r/, that is a rolled r, as in (soare) /ˈso̯a.re/. At the end of a word after a consonant, it makes the sound /rʲ/, that is a softened rolled r, as in (membri) /ˈmem.brʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not use the English smooth sound heard in red. Tap the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper front teeth. Do not curl your tongue backward into your mouth.
